repairs_since_overnight.change: A typed WorkUnit request that receives any upstream HTTP 200 semantic miss (missing required tool/structured content or invalid JSON-mode prose) receives a Hawking-owned MUTATION_PAYLOAD_MISSING envelope, not a fabricated local 502. Generic fail-closed 502 behavior remains outside that explicit typed route.

Mutation WorkUnits admit at most two focused observations, compile explicit read-only proposals into Hawking read tools, then remove the tool menu for patch synthesis. The provider is instructed to emit literal old_text/new_text or literal new_lines, never a prose change/source_edit intent.

A typed effect proposal that does not cross Hawking's canonical repo.edit gate is dead-lettered immediately for a fresh WorkUnit instead of consuming generic outer owner turns. This preserves NOT_RED_BEFORE and other rejection receipts without treating them as accepted work.

Cloud Auto retains DeepSeek, Kimi, and GLM routing. GLM 5.3 no longer receives reasoning: none because its upstream route requires reasoning; Kimi and DeepSeek retain bounded no-reasoning patch serialization.

After the controlled gateway reload, Auto refilled 13 newly free, disjoint writer scopes with no Hawking concurrency ceiling. Remaining candidates were excluded only for focus-file or writer-scope conflicts.
